mission: Make U.S. public statistics easier to explore by place, with maps, comparisons, and the context behind each value.

project.description: USA X-Ray brings place-based data into one atlas. It helps people explore places, compare matching measures, and follow each value back to its source and reference period.

creator.description: Built and maintained by Dmitrii Rybkin, an independent developer who enjoys maps and statistics.

methodology.geography: Mapped places use state and Census 2017 county-equivalent geographies with exact FIPS joins.
methodology.observations: Values keep their published geography, unit, reference period, source, and source release where available.
methodology.missingData: An unavailable or missing observation remains a visible gap. Values are not inferred from a coarser geography, and no U.S. average is substituted.
methodology.limitations: Coverage, definitions, units, and reference periods vary by source and measure. Read the source details for the selected indicator before comparing it.

improvements.title: 10 new indicators
improvements.description: Add ten new indicators with source links, observation periods and coverage notes. The final selection will follow data availability and quality checks.

improvements.title: An AI assistant for the map
improvements.description: Ask questions about a place or indicator, get help understanding measures, and explore comparisons on the map.

improvements.title: Clearer sources & methodology
improvements.description: Make definitions, sources, updates and missing values easier to understand, with a clearer way to report data issues.
